Frontend.reason: Vocabulary plan details now offer an explicit Send to Words flow. The dialog sends only a reviewed date, count, mode and non-content plan reference, validates the V1 response, keeps one operation id for identical retries, locks fields during submission and leaves every non-vocabulary plan unchanged.

Backend.reason: This UI consumes the formal Lexi repository's backward-compatible owner-scoped handoff RPC from step 1. Step 3 adds no Tracker schema or duplicated plan record; the shared backend keeps explicit authenticated execution, captured-account checks, fixed payload shape, operation-id idempotency, hard row caps and expiry cleanup.

Admin.reason: The transient plan intent contains no title, notes or learning content and is controlled only by its owning learner in Words. It introduces no administrator configuration, moderation case, support action or durable analytics entity, while its lifecycle is already bounded by the shared cleanup contract.

Deployment.reason: Neither the Supabase migration nor either step-3 client has been deployed. Production release remains blocked until both repository gates pass, the exact migration is applied and remotely verified first, and the verified Words, Control and Tracker sources are deployed and smoke-tested together.

Verification.reason: The complete Tracker gate passed typecheck, oxlint, 76 test files with 474 tests, pinned production build and bundle review. The formal Lexi gate also passed learner, Control and Account builds plus all contract and regression suites. Desktop and mobile browser checks verified localized labels, success state, responsive stacking and no horizontal overflow or fresh-page console warnings.
